description: List vouchers (Belege): receipts and supplier invoices (Ausgaben, kind=expense) and other income documents (Einnahmen, kind=revenue). Filter by status (draft = Entwurf, open = offen/fällig, transferred = überwiesen, partially_paid, paid = bezahlt), kind, supplier contact id or supplier name, Belegnummer/description, voucher date range and type (normal or recurring). Filters run in sevDesk; the type is also re-checked here (then rows are scanned, total is left out and filteredLocally is set). Exact amounts. Paged: pass nextOffset as offset while hasMore is true. Use detail=summary to browse/find. Use sevdesk_voucher_get for positions, tax rule and booking accounts. Find supplier ids with sevdesk_contacts_search.

description.description: Part of the Belegnummer or description, e.g. an invoice number.

detail.description: Use summary to browse/find; full (default) or the matching get tool for details.

from.description: First day to include, YYYY-MM-DD (Berlin time).

kind.description: expense (Ausgabe, creditDebit C) or revenue (Einnahme, creditDebit D).

offset.description: Rows to skip, for paging: pass the previous result's nextOffset.

supplierId.description: Contact id of the supplier (Lieferant) or customer.

supplierName.description: Part of the supplier name, for vouchers without a contact too.

to.description: Last day to include, YYYY-MM-DD (Berlin time).

name: sevdesk_vouchers_list
title: List sevDesk vouchers
